t: Essentials steel self-closing roller drawer runners offer reliable and smooth operation for various furniture applications. These 400mm steel drawer runners are ideal for upgrading kitchen cabinets, workshop benches, or office furniture, ensuring secure storage. The sturdy 1.1mm thick steel construction provides durability, while nylon rollers ensure quiet and effortless movement. Integrated roll-out prevention enhances safety, keeping contents secure. With a 20kg maximum weight capacity and fixings supplied, installation is straightforward via screw-on assembly.
